title: Tool error not recovered: patch_file (CRLF file on Windows)
description: The initial mcp__moeb__patch_file call failed with 'error applying hunk #1 — error applying hunk' because patch_file.rs had CRLF line endings on disk and the deployed MCP binary lacked the normalize_line_endings fix. The operation was recovered by falling back to write_file.
proposed_resolution: Rebuild and redeploy the moeb binary after this run so the MCP server uses the patched patch_file implementation with normalize_line_endings.

title: Spec Step 1 code example uses invalid Rust syntax: char vs &str
description: The specification's Step 1 code example uses replace('\r', '\n') where the second argument is a char literal. Rust's str::replace requires &str for the replacement argument, causing a compile error. The implementation was fixed to use replace('\r', "\n"). The spec is immutable so the discrepancy remains.
proposed_resolution: Add a rubric criterion or linting check that validates Rust code examples in spec Step sections against the Rust compiler before a spec is accepted, to catch type-level errors in examples before implementation.

title: Missing moeb tool: Bash (cargo test / cargo build)
description: Used Bash to run cargo test -p moeb and cargo build --release for the all-tests-pass and binary-builds rubric criteria. No moeb equivalent exists for shell command or build/test execution. This forces moeb-tool-origin to fail on every run that checks build and test criteria.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a run_command or cargo tool covering cargo build and cargo test execution, so rubric verification can be performed without external Bash calls.

title: patch_file.rs pre-existing context-budget violation (313 lines)
description: patch_file.rs was 303 lines before this run (already 3 over the 300-line budget) and reached 313 lines after adding normalize_line_endings and the normalization pipeline. Inline tests were extracted to the companion file to minimise the overage. Further reduction requires splitting relocate_hunk_positions or find_closest_context into a dedicated module file.
proposed_resolution: Author a targeted spec to extract relocate_hunk_positions and find_closest_context into patch_file_relocation.rs, reducing patch_file.rs to under 300 lines and enabling a clean context-budget pass in future runs.
